verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for an accounting SaaS platform with a public API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks; it covers only APIs, SDKs, an OpenAPI spec and an MCP server. Invoice-open tracking is an in-app notification, not a webhook a programmatic consumer can subscribe to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
